title: Defender-Attacker Framework for Evaluating Privacy Risks in Synthetic Data Sharing
summary: An ETH Zürich Data Science Lab project that benchmarks membership-inference attack risk across synthetic tabular data generators (Synthcity, Reprosyn, and SDV) using a defender/attacker pipeline. SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE) and its Metadata schema are imported and run as one of the generator families evaluated in the benchmark pipeline.
evidence: privacy/run_pipeline.ipynb:90-92 wraps GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer via SDVGenerator class
